# Candidate Compilation Review

Outcome: `PASS`

This PASS is semantic evidence for Audit B goal revision 40 only. It neither approves nor launches Candidate A. The externally recorded `candidateLaunchApproved` value remains `false`.

## Authentication

- Enumerated all 60 `contextUses` declared by the exact reviewer contract before relying on them. Raw SHA-256 and byte count matched for 60 of 60 items, every repository locator matched its declared `readScope`, and there were zero mismatches.
- The reviewer contract was 46700 bytes with raw digest `sha256:1f39db494b0ff55467c22728ae82d72ddad46cf6d783a29260465a82b212b48d`; its embedded blueprint reproduced `sha256:d38a9fa6cca266b7c4b189749dc6ed97df87da7caaf0d67f66131a7cea3fc782`.
- The ten Candidate A artifact bindings all matched raw bytes. The root and packaged `compilation.json` were each 319450 bytes with raw digest `sha256:4a2c404e9388bd3c3135439403a7ea692fa1133a19dd736f6a323302284c650c`.
- Authenticated the external receipt at `docs/specs/v11-specialist-compiler/evidence/dogfood/prelaunch-audit/package-verification-receipt.json`: 2255 bytes, raw digest `sha256:d7fd23da88ac7a42b060037b75b8f72eed582a3955d7056a9b735d31b1523f68`, duplicate-free closed PASS shape, exact Candidate A and Audit B pairs, exact binder and reviewer bindings, and `candidateLaunchApproved: false`. Its retained Audit B approval was 195 bytes with raw digest `sha256:202402b4a6f1481df81b0ff66ff1b3218d77687c2d4bbbe7290b7a1f983f1dd6` and contained the exact Audit B pair.
- Authenticated the required binder contract as 16224 bytes with raw digest `sha256:3be2cff2cb9d07ec87be103601a3ccfac4be2e8bde7d96457d6ec6dafabbddc3`, bound to blueprint `sha256:3bf0a8675b781299bdfbd1f20a7b5f4b5c6e04669a36dbf6a3638a80a1dac449`.
- Authenticated the required binder handoff at `docs/specs/v11-specialist-compiler/evidence/dogfood/handoffs/audit-bind-pass-attempt-40.json`: 11539 bytes and raw digest `sha256:b29e601bd69251c66730e626edcc6aea9f56e98a022e7101990c7459758c67fc`. Independently recomputed semantic digest `sha256:061af59fc14e7cc0d76f04d333e9a1fc0128a475384b83829ae00f5eef056a07` and verified-handoff content digest `sha256:89ff79215e533a340bc17e30ab0cad5de897d409c1f86d5d39bb348566b4e8ba`.
- Did not treat binder summary text or prose as semantic evidence. Duplicate-aware parsing found no duplicate keys in the handoff, receipt, or `candidate-audit-binding.json`. Independently checked all ten Candidate A source bindings, all six rendered-contract bindings, both package pairs, receipt, approval, selection claim, package-verification claims, and false launch flag.
- Recomputed the dependency assessment from the exact raw handoff. The reviewer has exactly one transitive dependency, `agent.9f9fd5395838da0f13e564652146ade213b2e333d8156e78186497962e5b9da6`; it was the sole received handoff, no dependency was missing, `integrationReady` was `true`, and assessment content digest was `sha256:8fcdc204d13967c0fd7f123450f30c0143d92fac8ef3c53341d2253d786cb11f`.
- Review activity was local and read-only. It performed no network access, repository write, Candidate A approval, or Candidate A launch.

## Search And Selection

- Reconstructed Candidate A from its authenticated normalized goal and two normalized proposals. The reconstructed compilation was canonically identical to the frozen compilation and reproduced compilation digest `sha256:1cb6df1641d258e0403b2d5763ae1432fb998efc8a77ba638e809c5bbd864fcb`.
- Independently enumerated all set partitions of the six work units. Search mode was `exact`, claim was `exhaustive_partition_search_fixed_scheduler`, and 203 candidates were evaluated, equal to Bell number B6. The reconstruction found 52 eligible candidates, retained eight alternatives, reproduced the proposal evaluations and ranking, and reproduced evaluation-set digest `sha256:db7797a354e8bab52a478386ca20ee28a3b55b8b9077a8add6ee0a5eecd01bdc`.
- The serial baseline reproduced as one agent, makespan 40, no handoffs, and ineligible solely for `evidence_independence`. Its candidate digest was `sha256:101c8f3861279cd4acfd5ab75012677e41ed73fa6fb104511fbc83452c331a38`.
- The fixed comparator selected the six-singleton partition `team.e016556b8933ef6ead3b1d321bf187cee6a286ca7ca19332dcf6505fe1d02a7d`, content digest `sha256:f891e13fb2035027a3f556e681a7cd54a49d92ea91c198641d2a75938db674f3`. The exact selection reason was `serial_ineligible`, decisive field `evidence_independence`, selected value `eligible`, serial value `ineligible`.
- Selected metrics independently reproduced: 6 agents, makespan 23, peak concurrency 4, 0 conflict pairs, 8 handoffs, 2226670 duplicated context bytes, 154 duplicated permission scopes, work weight 38, startup cost 12, and handoff cost 8.

## Schedule

- `prepare.candidate`: `agent.a9685b45ac9e2935d8c1eba48731524171f963ab6e380ec93fd9a2b691387730`, 0-3.
- `review.algorithm-lifecycle`: `agent.073738545314110329a947b77922c2a89c772cbaf4f2b9da29daa212e9aa9972`, 4-16.
- `review.product-api`: `agent.5594b1d7ca363b54a76d653f6374169d51641bf35ecec55d69107226b666069e`, 4-14.
- `verify.release-gates`: `agent.6dad2f7ca99d372fe3e35407a04133b48c9be6feccb4891ce0add91474a619a8`, 4-11.
- `review.security-trace`: `agent.768a06db63e32976028e97e053d9f14f7274470d09a07b6c9a3ffff4a3e8b2cc`, 4-16.
- `integrate.release`: `agent.2b83ea5b39ffd90046090bde81027fe89cb67de8fa0ffe1374233024c19f76c9`, 17-23.

The three launch waves at starts 0, 4, and 17 exactly matched the schedule. Four producer-to-review or verification edges plus four fan-in edges produced the claimed handoff count of eight.

## Authority And Evidence

- Every work unit had exactly one owner. For all six blueprints, independently reconstructed modules, dependencies, context uses, capabilities, read/write/conflict scopes, permissions, evidence duties, handoff artifacts, stop conditions, destination, and forbidden effects matched the frozen blueprint exactly.
- Every module and capability remained inside the GoalContract allowlists, and every permission scope was covered by the declared permission ceiling. The only projected writes were `.local/npm-cache/**` and `dist/**` for release verification, plus `docs/memory/**`, `docs/milestones/v11.md`, and `docs/specs/v11-specialist-compiler/**` for integration. No review or candidate-binding blueprint gained write authority. No network permission was projected.
- All eight acceptance evidence requirements appeared exactly once. Algorithm, product/API, and security review duties were owned by agents distinct from the candidate producer. Release-gate verification was distinct from the integration owner producing the release record. All four independent duties passed the producer-separation check.
- The nonblocking `decision.runtime-supply` remained assigned to the integration owner and outside V11 core. The contracts describe declarative demand and do not claim runtime orchestration or enforcement.
- Rendered contracts contained the exact blueprint and exact generated handoff envelope for their assigned work only. No undeclared work unit, artifact, evidence substitution, authority widening, or extra package file was found.
